svg.aria-label: Wanderlens — my MCA capstone. A social app for travellers and photographers to find community-verified, hyper-local photo spots. Spot feed + map, geo-tagged posts, connections, real-time chat and an AI photo-trail planner. Built with React Native, Expo, TypeScript, Supabase, PostGIS, Realtime, MapLibre, Gemini + Groq.
